Hello there! I can certainly help you understand our return and refund policy. 😊

We want you to love your Namesake product, but if you're having second thoughts, we're here to assist. If you purchased directly from namesakehome.com, you can contact us within 30 days of delivery to initiate a return.

To qualify for a refund, items must be sent back in new condition and in original packaging, with all components included. Please do not modify the product in any way. For mattresses, they must remain unopened and in their original packaging to be eligible for return.

Please note that some items are considered final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. This includes:

All Bedding products (sheets, blankets, wall decals, changing pad covers)
Items marked as final sale
Newton Baby Mattresses
'Extend' Warranty Fees
Free Returns & Package Protection Premiums
Gift Cards

Regarding return shipping costs:

If you purchased Return & Exchange Coverage at checkout, your return shipping label will be covered for eligible items.
If you chose not to buy return & exchange coverage, you will need to cover the cost of the return shipping label, which is typically about 25% of the retail value of the item.

To initiate a return or exchange, please use our Namesake Returns Portal. After your request is accepted, you'll receive your return label and instructions via email.

Once your return is received and inspected, you can expect to receive a refund to your original payment method (Credit Card or Store Credit) within 3-5 days after it has been delivered back to our facilities.

We recommend keeping the original packaging until you are sure you will not need to make a return or exchange, as this greatly simplifies the process.

You can review our full return policy on our Returns & Exchanges page here.
